config.accountLabels.description: Names for the two accounts, shown instead of A and B: for example {"A": "work", "B": "personal"}. 1 to 24 characters (letters, digits, spaces, _ . -); the two names must differ. A missing or invalid name falls back to the letter. Easiest to set with “Twinseat: Name an account…”.
config.account.description: The account this project uses: a name set in “Twinseat › Account Labels”, or A or B. Put it in the project's .vscode/settings.json (or run “Twinseat: Pin this project to the current account”) and every window on this project opens on that account, with no menu. If it names no account, it is ignored and a warning is shown.
